profile.headline: iOS Software Engineer - Wallet and Apple Pay at Apple
profile.jobTitle: iOS Software Engineer - Wallet and Apple Pay

positions.title: iOS Software Engineer - Wallet and Apple Pay
Contractor
positions.description:
Main iOS developer, in charge of UI design and feature implementation.
Designed the mobile application's database structure using Core Data.
Integrated AFNetworking as a backend communication solution after upgrading from RestKit.
Designed and implemented the beta for an Apple Watch companion app in Swift.
Maintained libraries that enabled doctors to seek and edit existing audio recordings.
Designed scenes for the user interface in Storyboard, utilizing Auto Layout.
Working with another developer to create the Android/iOS version of the app.

positions.title: Backend Engineer / Mobile Programmer
positions.description: Comprehensive implementation of in-app purchases, provisioning profiles, TestFlight integration, and assisted as needed across all aspects of development.

positions.title: Database Intern
positions.description: Worked on implementing a Cassandra database structure to help lessen bottlenecks created by database changes being required for simple features.

positions.title: Data Analysis Intern
positions.description: Worked on configuration of the virtual controller for mobile client releases and on the virtual controller that launched with the OnLive Android client. In addition to analyzing internal data of end user experienced.

projects.title: Puzzle Defenders
projects.description: A completely HTML 5 game utilizing node.js for real time networking. A real time competitive puzzle game you can play with your friends.

projects.title: Cleane: SBRT
projects.description: Side-scrolling action platformer made for Junior Game Design at UCSC
